mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.customer_type, a.customer_name, a.customer_address, a.customer_phone, a.customer_identity, a.customer_source, a.belong_grid_code, a.belong_grid_name, a.filing_manager_code, a.filing_manager_name, a.filing_org_code, a.filing_org_name, a.filing_progress, a.filing_source, a.filing_status, a.filing_date, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.customer_introducer_identity, a.customer_address_type, a.customer_nm, a.model_id, a.customer_photo, a.clock_in, a.branch_bank, a.grid_manager,u2.nick_name, a.separate_bank, a.filing_manager_code as credit_manager_jobNumber, a.filing_manager_name as credit_manager, u.dept_id,u.user_id,sd.ancestors,cgc.custom_group_id,pait.ancestor_codes FROM custom_group_customer cgc left join filing_customer_info a on a.id = cgc.customer_id left join sys_user u on a.filing_manager_code = u.manager_num left join sys_user u2 on a.grid_manager = u2.manager_num left join sys_dept sd on u.dept_id= sd.dept_id left join pa_addr_info_type pait on a.belong_grid_code = pait.code where cgc.custom_group_id = #{groupId} limit #{startIndex},#{endIndex}
